~When embers dance in the twilight, a forgotten power awakens~
===Announcement Trailer===
WARNINGS
​
The game contains lots, lots of battles.
​
It's fiction, a lot of things won't make sense (The guns, and so on)
​
SYNOPSIS/FEATURES
​
Spoiler
Shadows of the Earth: The Vrila'an Legend tells the story of a fallen god, looking for revenge against a human who, because of his power, was able to attack his realm, and kill all of his peers. But why did this happen?
Travel as Joseph, the God of Courage, in order to find people who can help you fight this powerful foe, and find your siblings who you never got to know while in Efgartha, the realm of the gods to uncover the mystery that unleashed this war.
Being a game heavily focused on battles
and inspired by the Tales of Series
, Shadows of the Earth: The Vrila'an Legend uses a special iteration of the
Linear Motion Battle System
Completed Evolved Legacy - Linear Motion Battle System
​
Control a character in real time battles against groups of enemies both in ground and air.​
Unleash amazing attacks with inmense power known as
Elents
(You can spam them, don't worry).​
Maximize your combos with
Chain Elents:
Follow up Elents activated by a single button.​
Skyrocket your damage with
Altered Union Elents
:
Special Elents that are a force to be reckoned with.​
When the enemy is too powerful, activate
Overflux
to gain knockback/stun resistance and no cost for Elents.​
Ascend into
Spirit Force
as your last resort to win the battle.​
Fill your Limit Gauge and unleash one of three
Limit Elents
:
Elents that are the culmination of elemental mastery of the characters.​
Seamless character switch mid-battle.​
No Spell-pause:
Spells never stop the action from happening!​
Mobile Casting:
Mages can reposition at any time to avoid damage.​
Skill Cancels
: Cancel any elent to begin another, and keep your enemies in the ropes!​
Target Lock-on
. Start the battle ready to cast spells at a single foe, or change your target at any time.​
Blink Chase:
An special ability that allows you to pursue enemies during a combo, no matter how far you launch them.​
Guard Counters:
When you break a boss' shield, it will try to one up you with a special move, block it on its face then combo them into oblivion!​
Multiplayer: Join forces with up to 3 friends to bring an end to this war.
​
Battle up to 8 foes with in-map encounters on. World map has random encounters.​
Fight against massive bosses with a single objective: decimating you.​
Engage human enemies that can also perform combos and Limit Elents: May the strongest win.​
Not enough of a challenge? Face off against Wandering Bosses: Powerful monsters that roam the entire country of Angorian looking for a showdown.​
Difficulties: From Training to Chaos, change difficulties to learn the gimmicks of the battle system or empower enemies to challenge yourself.​
Customizable AI:
Choose from AI presets, set up specific targets, a general tactic and the use items to coordinate your allies' movements!​
Character and Equipment Features
​
With 16 characters to choose from, create formations up to 4 characters in battle.
(Plus 12+ Collabs!)
​
Equip up to
16 Elents
per character
(2 Sets of 4 Ground + 4 Aerial )
to engage.​
Increase your combo potential with
Fluxites
to increase your FLUX Capacity.​
With many accesories and armors, turn your characters into Glass Cannons or Steel Walls. Customize them as deeply as you want!​
Equip weapons and improve them via
Boost Stones!
​
Skins! Characters have access to more skins to customize their aspect slightly! From tuxedos to armor changes!​
Earn titles by doing specific actions. All characters have access to titles.​
Upgrade equipment with augments: Special Parts that increase stats, grant bonuses and even allow you to learn new elents!.​
Craft
augments
with monster parts, or find them exploring.​
Spend
Potential Energy Shards
to activate special effects upon equipping
Passive Elents
​
Or even better, trigger C-Skills to help your allies any time in battle!
​
Delve into the world's mysteries and events:
​
Explore Angorian: Many locations await adventurers to find treasure, or to free them from the claws of evil.​
Join the cast in exploring their lives, and how their fates connect to each other.​
Cooking! Cook dishes that offer healing, battle perks such as stat increases, resistances, and permanent bonuses!​
Save the world from a second threat in
Echoes of the Rift
: An event that reunites many heroes from the RPG Maker Community!​
Skits!​
Shadows of the Earth fully supports gamepads now: plug it and enter the fight!
​
​
CHARACTERS
​
Spoiler
Spoiler:
Heroes
Joseph
The last god in Efgartha. Joseph embodies the spirit of courage, and embarks in a journey to find the human that was able to destroy his realm, and get revenge. Joseph uses Fire as his primary element, with swords as his primary weapon.
Perla
Marshall of West Angorian. Saving Joseph from drowning, she resolves to help him due to political affairs rather than personal ones. Uses Water as her primary element, wielding a greatsword, and high defense.
Alex
A hunter, renowned for his sight and accuracy. He is Perla's brother, he's been always a loner, and will stay that way, as long as his sister is safe. Darkness is his primary element. He wields a pair of weapons known as handcannons, and fights at distance. (In game terms and history)
Wendy
Perla's daughter, Wendy is an energetic girl who sometimes is too energetic for herself. She has a lot to learn from the world... and herself.
Uses water as her primary element. Wields a spear and can fight in the air more time than the others.
Takeshi
A swordwielder from a distant land. Friendly with Perla, Takeshi belongs to a clan that settled on Angorian, and from then, Takeshi has been helping out. Wind is his primary element, and wields a curved shaped sword known as a katana (In game terms and history).
Cielo
An elent master, Cielo is known for her elemental mastery and overall knowledge. She appears to recognize Joseph... are they related?
Wields a staff as her weapon, and can control Ice and Light elements. Can also channel Healing Elents.
Mike
A retired veteran from the Army. Mike comes back due to a series of events that leds him to join Joseph's side to resolve these events.
Uses an axe as his weapon, and wields Thunder elents.
Charles
A new recruit into the army. Charles joined in hopes of getting enough Silva to take his sister with him to cure her from an unknown sickness caused by a demon. Wields a hammer, and is an avid spellcaster. Uses Earth Elents.
Ryan
A man knoledgeable in martial arts. Ryan traveled from a far land and settled in Angorian due to the attacks that demons have been doing.
Wields gauntlets, and uses Wind as his primary element.
Stella
Part of the Velhi'koz tribe, Stella left her tribe after saving a man from the outerlands, in hopes of exploring these off-limits.
Wields claws, knows martial arts, and uses Wind as her element.
Solat
The Riding Squad Leader, Solat joins the team due to Perla's insistence in keeping tabs on him, due to his hotheaded nature.
Wields a hammer, and uses Thunder as his primary element.
Shadow
A demon paladin, Shadow was defeated by
him
, and was banished to the mortal realm: Terraquia. He awaits for allies to challenge his fated foe again. Wields two swords, with Darkness as his element.
Titania
.
A librarian and a healer, Titania traveled to Angorian following the havoc of
his
forces, to reach out to those who can still be saved.
Wields a book, and uses Light as her primary element. She can empower allies and weaken enemies.
Spoiler:
Antagonists
Kamil Zepphri
The human who began everything, he is the one that brought down the gods, and will consume Thessea.
Edmund Gaiax
Kamil's right hand, a great strategist and commander with a long hatred for gods.
Gianna Crestfallen
Kamil's self proclamed lover and assistant. She will do everything in her power to make her beloved happy.
???
An unknown foe who lurks in the dark with mysterious powers.​
More enemies await you in the lands of Terraquia!​
STORYLINE/PLOT
Spoiler
A long time ago, gods were thriving in Efgartha. They gave their gifts to those who lived in Terraquia: the mortal realm. They watched as humans improved more and more, until they were able to reach them. By this time, Gods created artifacts that granted humans who found them, their innermost wishes.
One day, an emperor, claimed to be the most thoughtful and generous by his people, found an artifact: The Kaileg Stone. Instead of claiming his wish, he secured the stone and changed its location in hopes of safekeeping it from wrong hands, but a sneaky demon followed him...
Days later, a portal appeared in Efgartha, and many gods flocked to the phenomenon, since no human had been capable of reaching them since early days.
Their surprise was great, as an army emerged from the portal, with clear intent of killing them. But their plan had one mistake: Gods can't be killed on Efgartha.
Said mistake was quickly corrected, by opening more portals and throwing them to Terraquia, were immortality held no importance. The entire pantheon was slaughtered... but by a miracle, a single god survived, the youngest of them... The God of Courage.
Armed with the knowledge of his lost family, and the name of his foe, the young god traveled to Terraquia, intent on exacting revenge against his enemy.
WORLD DEVELOPMENT
​
Spoiler
The Vrila'an Legend is set on the universe of Athelia Prime. The adventure itself takes place on the world called Thessea.
One of many worlds that have seen many tales arise, and be told to future generations.
Thessea is divided in three realms.​
Efgartha: The Realm of the Gods.​
Terraquia: The Mortal Realm​
Neviliham: The Realm of the Demons.​
The three realms were in peace, but Neviliham never interacted with the other two realms. Until
he
brought a catasthrope to the entire world.
The world is governed by two energies:​
Ether: The elemental energy that exists in everything and empowers Ether Elents.​
Flux: The physical energy that envelopes every living thing, and allows superior feats.​

This is a big post.
First of all, let me start with the demos: Both demos have been merged into one, meaning.
The Basic Demo and the Advanced Demo are one now, the game will prompt for an option, whether you want to play the basic or the advanced.
Spoiler:
Giga-Post (Changelog)
As for what each demo entails:
The basic demo contains the first minutes of the game (Truly, this time there's almost no game breaking bugs i swear) allowing you to play with up to 4 characters until the second story boss. You also get a preview of what is the upgrade system, the Passive Elent System, and Chain Elent skill.
The advanced demo is for those who already played the outdated basic demo version, since this new one and the old  are the same (just without the bugs). This demo contains a bit more of story, 8 characters and almost all features of the
Advanced Technical Multishift Linear Motion Battle System
, which are:​
- Chain Elent Skill
- Alteration Elent Skill
- Limit Elent Skill
- Overflux Skill
- Blink Chase Skill
Along with these features, certain battles for your enjoyment have been added, so you can play for as long as you want:
- Makeria Cameo Battle (These will almost literally kick your ass)
-> Rook Valorie (GenericFantasyDev's Cameo Character)
-> Black Mage (Black Mage's Cameo Character)
-> O'Donell (TRIDIUM's Cameo Character)
-> Holder (Holder's Cameo Character)
- Normal Rank Arena Battle (These not so much)
- Easy Rank Arena Battles (Neither those)
- 2 Wandering Bosses (These might kick your ass)
Also, here's the changelog
- Fixed load game bug
- Fixed weird crash related to YEP_AutoPassiveStates
To avoid this, you might have to eat an extra cutscene during boss fights. Thankfully, losing a random encounter will only throw you out of the fight. (Unless you're at the... i can't say yet
).
- Fixed event after defeating Miner Orc
- Fixed Font being unreadable
- Fixed Incorrect Gamepad Buttons
- Changed Tutorial overlay to reflect the correct control schemes
-> Tutorial prompts now are split for Keyboard and Gamepad: The game will try to listen for any gamepads during the tutorial, and will display only the buttons for the gamepads. Else, it will display keyboard keys. (Currently under test, you can select your preferred device on the Basic Demo)
- Fixed A.I going dumb after selecting Easy as difficulty
- Slightly improved A.I Decision making in increased difficulties
- Small fixes to various Elents.
- Fixed Takeshi and Perla having the wrong starter Elents equipped.
- Slightly improved performance thanks to NW.js update
- Fixed Normal Attack Chain not working in demo.
- Fixed warning about encounters not appearing correctly after leaving the Bridge
- Fixed Guard button not working in gamepads.
- Fixed some events going too fast, so fast that the event reposition and dissapearance was shown
- Fixed some Elents having Spanish Translation that should not be available yet
- Fixed "ENEMY" HP Bar appearing also on "ALLIES"
- Fixed wrong spell casting reductions and calculation
- FOCUS no longer affects casting time. Instead, effectiveness has been raised towards affecting Status Effects, FLUX Reload amount, and Critical Hit Strength.  A high FOCUS count will grant increased critical power and stun duration
- Added an extra menu after losing a boss fight: You can retry the battle, load your saved game or go to the main menu
- Added Learn Potential tab to the main menu. More info in-game
- Added the first shop in Berdem. Starter Kit is still given to players (5 Ether Apples, 5 Ether Oranges)
- Added Spellcast Bars: These bars show the progress related to spells. Appear for both allies and enemies
- Added Sound Test: Allows you to listen to the songs you've heard at least once. It may contain spoilers.
- Reduced enemy attack regularity
- Reduced Enemy HP
- Normal attacks have been overhauled. Takeshi explains the new mechanic before entering Eidolon Mines
-> Each character has access to 4 base normal attacks. Can be extended up to 7 with the Combo Plus skills
-> Mage Characters have only access to one normal attack.
- Increased Duration of Dodge
Now displays the text PERFECT! when sucessfully dodging an impact
- Replaced Rising Strike (Joseph) with a stronger version.
- Changed Rising Strike usability type from Aerial to Free
- Replaced Burning Edge (Joseph) with a stronger version
- Ally/User Spell time slightly increased.
- Certain team skills are now available during the basic demo.
-> All Team skills are available in the advanced demo
- Takeshi's Union Elents have new knockback properties.
-> Chain properties have been tweaked.
- (Not on Demo) Wendy's Elents have been tweaked
-> Lunar Rondo reworked
-> Sapphire Spear Sigma reworked
-> Tearing Moon's hitboxes adjusted
-> Riptide's hitboxes adjusted
- (Not On Demo) Mike's Elents have been tweaked
-> Thunder Crescent's knockback increased.
-> Decreased damage on Power Wave
-> Increased Movement Length on Sonic Strike
- (Not On Demo) Ryan's Elents have been tweaked
Combo capabilities have been improved in:
- Wyrm Hurricane
- Hurricane Orb
- High Impact
- Palm Strike
- Lightspeed Strike
- Finished new mechanic -> Blink Chase​
Blink Chase is a Passive Elent that unlocks the ability to chase enemies when some moves launch them too far. This ability needs to be equiped in the Offense slots, and to activate its effect "C" is to  held down during the move.
After the last hit of the Elent, the character will "Link" on the enemy, following it as long as its in the hitbox. This ability can only be used by the controlled character, provided that the ability itself is equipped. (Currently not working on Gamepads)
- Updated Sprites / HUD's / Animations
- Chain animation added
- Alteration animation added
- Battler Visual Updates
>Most Battlers now have their weapons out during the fight.
>Added animations for enemies
>Some bosses have improved animations (They're still somewhat static)
Sadly mapping is still awful
Always remember to check the Guide if you forget something!
Please let me know if any bugs arise.
Download Links are already updated!
Have fun!

posts.author: TESTOSTERONE
posts.body:
Ok, since you are a stand up guy, Erif, and I want to help you succeed with this project, I'll try to be honest with my feedback in the 30 minutes that I spent playing the
Basic Demo
. First impressions are everything, right? [Plus I think I may have gotten as far as I could go b/c the game crashed when I got to Torre Gotjin].
Spoiler:
Like
(+) Opening theme, it's beautiful.
(+) Art, your drawings are really nice and the art is consistent. By the way, you did not encode your files so you may want to do that.
(+) Battle system is chaotic, crazy, and most of the time I had no idea what was going on, and yet it's kinda cool. Seeing characters doing attacks, and everything moving and numbers flying around the screen, it's certainly different from other things I've tried before.  With that said, I was only pressing "d" and playing on easy mode. I'm not sure what it would feel like on harder difficulty.
(+) The amount of experience I was gaining (especially at the beginning) was nice. I quickly leveled up to level 8 I think. And it's cool that enemy levels also adjust as you level up. Although if executed poorly then it becomes a pain - like Skyrim and Final Fantasy 8.
Spoiler:
Suggestions / Improvements
(-) Mapping. They are bland. A lot of empty space. Would like those to be prettier. I've been spoiled by seeing pretty RPG Maker maps lately.
(-) Menu. I believe you are using MOG for main menu, and those grey icons just don't fit with the beautiful art. I know MOG doesn't play nicely with Yanfly, but I'd still like to see different Equip, Item and Skill screens.  Status screen looks cool though, here the color and the art match pretty well.
(-) Some phrases and item finds were in Spanish. (And I really wanted to know what they were saying).
(--) This one was a big one for me. For a demo, I've no idea where the story is going and characters feel very un-natural at the moment. I did not feel a connection with any of the characters. I think you were concentrating mostly on the battle system for now and not as much on the story?
(-) Think about adding a quest journal.
(-) Thank you for making visible encounters inside dungeons, but it was impossible to avoid certain enemies for me. I'd like more choice to the player of whether or not to fight. And because I was running into battles so often, the battle system became tediously repetitive rather than enjoyable.
Spoiler:
Bugs
Map JSON file was missing for the Torre Gotjin
What do we do here Joseph? We become one with the wall, Perla.
Hope this little feedback helps. It's meant to help you improve your project, not to criticize your hard work.

posts.author: Erif
posts.body:
An Extensive description of the ATM-LMBS
(Advanced Technical Multishift - Linear Motion Battle System)
​
THE ATM-LMBS is a derivative of the Original Linear Motion Battle System used in the Tales of Series, and the Plugin made by Moghunter, and upgraded by Fillip.
The Advanced Technical Multishift Linear Motion Battle System is a variant of the original Linear Motion Battle System produced by Moghunter. It's called advanced because of the many features that set it appart from its roots.
The LMBS allows for real-time combat with you controlling your own character. You can input commands to perform actions at any time.​
Basic Actions
​
All characters have access to normal attacks, however, there are some differences on how these normal attacks work.
- Caster & Ranged characters only have access to one normal attack.
- Cameo Characters have access to two or four attacks (Depends on the character).
All other characters have access to four normal attacks, and can increase them to a max of 7 via Passive Elents.
Every single character has access to a set of predefined actions called Common Actions. These actions have no inmediate cost like Elents, but some of them need special requirements to be used. These actions are allocated into the "F" Button currently.
F (No added input) triggers a Limit Elent if the conditions are met, or an Alteration if the last elent used was of Union Type and its Alteration is learned.
F + Up triggers Overflux, and Spirit Force if the conditions are met and the character is already in Overflux
F + Right or Left performs a dodge.
F + Down triggers FLUX Reload.
Dodges
are a costless action that allows you to evade damage of any attack, provided you input them at the right time. They also serve as a way to connect combos easier with certain elents that aren't capable of normally.
Other basic actions are Jumping, Air Dashing, Character Switch and Guarding. You can double jump always.
Airdashing
allows you to circle closer to the enemy while in the air.
Guarding
nullifies physical and projectile damage, but it can't stop Ether Elents.
Character Switch
allows you to quickly go to the next character in battle to control them (This action is disabled in Multiplayer)​
Battle Resources.
​
There are three battle resources used in the game. EP, FLUX & SP.
EP
Stands for Ether Points, which are the resource used to perform Union & Ether Elents. While usually high, these costs can be reduced via Passive Elents or Accesories.
SP
Stands for Shield Points: This resource is gained by certain Passive Elents, or Character Elents, such as Perla's Tempest Wall. It allows protection of HP by creating a second layer of health that takes all damage for the HP. There are, however, many ways to break this resource, since its also present in Bosses and Human type Enemies. Skills such as Steel Breaker and Destructive Force increase damage to SP.
FLUX
is a very special resource since its gained and maintained very differently. Also called internally "Aggresion Meter", it behaves the following way: If you're being too aggressive, with long combos, the FLUX Meter never decays, and stays at its level. If you hit and run, the FLUX meter will be consumed by each Elent you perform this way. Triggering Overflux also depletes  the FLUX meter slowly, until it reaches a minimum of five. Performing Limit Elents without combo conditions also deplete the FLUX Meter by 30 points. At the start, your max FLUX is 10 points, but you can increase this limit.
FLUX is gained by using normal attacks, or triggering FLUX Reload, which gives a random amount.​
Elent Classifications
Base
Mainly advanced normal attacks, these Elents consume FLUX, and can be chained into other Base Elents. When the chain is about to end, it upgrades into:​
Union
These Elents have always the main Element of the character as Elemental Damage, and are increasingly more powerful than Base Elents. These elents consume only EP​
Ether
Also called Spells, these Elents always land on the enemy, but can still be dodged. These ignore Guard and have a certain cast time.​
Altered Union
A direct upgrade from Union Elents, these elents consume a massive amount of EP, but can be directly altered from Union Elents for free.​
Healing
They do not need a clarification. These only consume EP and can heal, revive dead allies, increase stats and even cure from status effects.​
Limit
The last type, these can be triggered by pressing its corresponding key and have a cut-in of the character. Insanely powerful and have three levels.​
Level one requires 30 FLUX​
Level two requires Overflux activated and a 2 hit-combo at least.​
Level three requires Spirit Force activated and a 2-hit combo at least.​
Advanced Actions
​
Alterations
This is a variant of the Chain effect added to the LMBS by Fillip, it allows your current Elent to be upgraded into a stronger version with a single button, allowing you to extend your combos and increasing your damage massively. Currently only Union Elents can turned into Altered Union Elents.
Overflux
Called Overlimit in other games, this addition allows you to resist stun and knockback totally, reduce the cost of your elents to 0, reduces casting time if your character is a caster, and lets you use your level 2 Limit Elent. It can be manually triggered or by the effect of a passive elent.
Limit Elents
While its not exactly a new addition, it is a new addition in the branch of this LMBS version. At the end of a combo, if you meet the requirements, you can perform an excedingly powerful elent known as Limit Elent (Mystic Arte in the competition).
Blink Chase
A new mechanic, it allows you be able to pursue your enemy ignoring the knockback of your attacks, teleporting instantly into its face. It allows you to chain elents which you can't normally chain because of their knockback.
​
​
Spirit Force
Non existant in other games, the Spirit Force is a new level of Overflux that allows the transformation of all characters, which increases their stats, gives them a new appearance and changes some elents into new forms. These new elents are called Assault Elents and for casters, Divine Ether Elents. To be triggered, the character needs to be in Overflux only. This mode temporarily increases the FLUX Meter maximum limit by 20, and has all the benefits of the Overflux ability.
Multiplayer
While not shown yet, The ATM-LMBS allows for local multiplayer. With a max of 4 controllable characters in battle, the camera zooms out a bit to allow for a greater view of the battlefield for all characters. All actions (basic & advanced) are available for all characters, the only thing missing is menu access.
​
​
Aerial Combat
Not present in any of its predecessors (talking about Mog's and Fillip's), the ATM-LMBS allows for airtime during combos, which can be extended thanks to Blink Chase. The best character to prove this is Wendy.​
General Info.
​
While the player is actively prompted to use all four members in the battle party, there's no penalization for using three, two, or only one character. Some Passive Elents are made to enhance single character survival, and some abilities are triggered thanks to party members being present. Play however you want!
All characters have access to 4 Ground elents and 4 Aerial Elents. There are elents that can be used on both slots, so choose your elents carefully to perform the best combos. You can always change those in the fly!​
This was inspired by LionessPaladin

Guest Heroes: Tips, Tricks, and Insight!
​
Spoiler:
Fia
Fia
Coming from the world of
Xelia Chronicle: The Last Order
, Fia is a powerful dark-elemental caster/close quarter hybrid. In Shadows of the Earth, this translates into long stuns with spells and the possiblity to get closer to execute a melee combo without any worry.  However, Fia lacks in the defense department and unless you're so good at dodging you might as well see the future, playing with her might cause you to use a few Ether apples in fights where enemies are diverse. Characters who can protect allies via knockback to enemies, Shields, or continuous Healing are a great partner for her!
Recommended Characters to pair (In order of... viability?)
​
Perla (Via Tempest Wall, Stream Wall, Fortify or equipping her with Share Shield)
​
Solat (Via Lighting Wall,  Lightning Hunter)
​
Takeru (Via Wall of Cards, Laplace Mine or using Seal: X)​
Spoiler:
Prim
Prim
Our favorite Elf girl from
Wind Ryder
, Prim can quickly dish damage at close quarters, and since she is not dependant on any Element she is a well rounded (Notice the joke) character perfect for any situation.
Except when the enemy has a lot of casters with rapid spell chanting. Some enemies can
speed up
the spell casting thanks to their allies buff. This turns into a problem for Prim since her
Elent Defense
is too low and her range is the same. Characters who can help her at distance against casters are the best choice!
Recommended Characters to pair (In order of... viability?)
​
Alex (All of his Elents are ranged)
​
Fidel (Her support can increase Attack, regenerate HP and EP, and this can increase Prim's lifespan greatly specifically in these situations)
​
Cielo (Ironically, the best at Healing and Attacking at range is the last option since she requires at least Speed Cast II to be able to provide cover for Prim)
​
Spoiler:
Tiqee
Tiqee
After escaping from a Dungeon, this lovely goblin unleashed her creativity to be able to fight, and what a punch she packs! With the ability to stun, and seal Union, Altered and Ether Elents at will she can quickly become a perfect support for fast damage dealers.
Provided she also has a support. While having a support kit, Tiqee is quickly overwhelmed against stalling enemies, since she can't deal massive damage or resist it. Any character that can keep foes away from her in these cases until she is able to unleash her Limit Elent are a boon!
Recommended Characters to pair (In order of... viability?)
​
Mike (Mike is a powerhouse and when paired with Tiqee they both will destroy the battlefield)
​
Shadow (Shadow can quickly dish damage and reposition himself near Tiqee to protect her)
​
Ryan (Being fast on reflexes and with the ability to refill his FLUX bar quickly, he's a great choice, if there's a defense character present too, since he's a glass cannon)
​
Spoiler:
Fidel
Fidel
Don't be fooled by her innocent appearance. Having fallen into a trap by "The Maker", she made her way to Thessea to perhaps gain some help, or better herself to face her foe.
Her
Confidence
has given her access to a very powerful, albeit limited, set of Ether Elents that vary from element. She can cancel her Ether Elents into Union Elents when near an enemy! Using the Ego Artifex Peritus enchantment she can summon statues that grant a myriad of effects. These statues can be Altered by the Alter Elent skill to invert their effect! HP turns into EP, Attack turns into Defense and Focus turns into Critical Chance! An awesome support for the price of having to dodge massively in boss fights and having two defensive characters to protect her so she can use her talents.
Recommended Characters to pair (In order of... viability?)
​
Perla (Via Tempest Wall, Stream Wall, Fortify or equipping her with Share Shield)
​
Amatos (He's more efficient in boss fights due to his deal damage/steal life attacks)
​
Takeru (Via Wall of Cards, Laplace Mine or using Seal: X)​
Spoiler:
Takeru
Takeru
A guy who was "isekai'd" (his terms, wonder what that is) that can use traps, and seal elents. Is he awesome? Yes, he is, provided you can offset is non-existant melee prowess. While he can deal on his own with some enemies, if they guard he loses his powerful advantage. However, when paired with any caster, he excels at protecting them since he has a high
Elent Defense.
Recommended Characters to pair (In order of... viability?)
​
Cielo (Our resident Spellcaster, she can go wild if he's present in the battlefield keeping enemies in check)
​
Titania (Can hit and provide support to him, a perfectly symbiotic relationship)
​
Allannia (Allannia can deal with mostly anything that doesn't get close, they both lack any close quarter Elents)
​
Spoiler:
Amatos
Amatos
Coming from the world of
Spirit Stone: Revelations
, Amatos is a powerful character to have due to his kit being a weird mix of Melee and Healing. In boss fights, he's self suficient to kick their ass and still be able to provide support to his allies.
BUUUUT, in group fights, Amatos performance falls greatly due to the following factors: He can't deal with being damaged and heal at the same time, since his spells and moves that heal leave him open. Defensive characters can't help much but any Stun-related character will give him some room to breathe.
Recommended Characters to pair (In order of... viability?)
​
Stella (All of her moves push the enemy back or stun them)
​
Mike (Via Lightning Hunter, and paralysis)
​
Joseph (Our allrounder, can keep enemies at bay for a while due to his massive HP pool, however, he cannot stall for long without any support)​
Spoiler:
Allannia
Allannia
From the same world as Tiqee, Allannia can quickly overwhelm opponents even if they have a high
Elent Defense
thanks to her ability to extend her Elents for increased damage. The only drawback is that she will deplete her EP bar almost instantly, and she lacks any base elents besides her normal attack to defend herself. Any character that can finish off any enemies that are left alive after her barrage of attacks works well with her.
Recommended Characters to pair (In order of... viability?)
Joseph (Our all rounder again, can synergize well with mostly everyone,  in this case Joseph can quickly deal with enemies left)
Wendy (First time appearing, once she elevates the remaining enemies in the air the battle has been won)
Takeshi (He's a literal glass cannon)
Spoiler:
Scarlet
Scarlet
The chaos maiden of
Dime a Dozen
can defend herself pretty well against any type of enemy that
isn't
resistant to fire. Otherwise, she'll eat through their healthbars pretty quickly with an avalanche (ironically) of Ether, Union & Base Elents. However, in terms of Defense, she has pretty much none, so any character that can protect her (although she will complain) will definitely help her finish faster.
Recommended Characters to pair (In order of... viability?)
Perla (Via Tempest Wall, Stream Wall, Fortify or equipping her with Share Shield)
​
Solat (Via Lighting Wall,  Lightning Hunter)
​
Takeru (Via Wall of Cards, Laplace Mine or using Seal: X)​

Sorry I haven't updated for a while!
I've been working off in the completion of Arc 1, and while I can't exactly spoil you guys let's say there's roughly 60 "primary" events (Which i've opted to divide the story on) and i'm on event 28. There's a lot to share!
First some screenshots of the new places where some events will happen.
​
There's a lot to unpack here so I'll make a spoiler if you want to read it.
Spoiler:
Lots of things
All Cameo Battles are working as intended. Once you clear them, you must recruit all the characters to be able to unlock the rest of the cameo Battles
For example, to access the Third Cameo Battle you must clear the second cameo battle and recruit Fia, Prim, Fidel & Tiqee. The leader of the cameo battle will appear outside the arena to let you recruit them!
Stores finally exist so you can now spend your hard earned Silva!
In exchange of reducing HP pools, enemies are now slightly harder to beat.
All enemies now properly drop at least 1 unit of Potential Energy Shards
Added [Female] and [Male] Specific Accesories. This allows for a more deep level of customization.
-> These accesories provide stronger bonuses at the cost of stronger drawbacks. For example, the [Emerald Hairpin] recovers 1 FLUX per hit. But it also can heavily reduce Attack or Elent Attack.
-> These accesories can be found at any chest, but cannot be bought. When sold they're well paid!
-> Some accesories are able to improve elents, such as reducing casting time for Ether Elents or Guaranteed Critical Strikes for Base Elents!
To prevent any issues, there are also Common Accessories and Armors! These give less bonuses, are cheaper to acquire at stores, can be dropped by enemies too and are a tier short! But they can be equipped by any character! This also of course includes the Cameo Characters!
I hope to be able to provide another demo once i reach event 35 and iron out any kinks and bugs that might appear, until the next "devlog"!

Hello everyone! Bit of sad news.
​
After yesterday's beating, i've decided to remove the game temporarily. It was called janky as if it wasn't functioning properly. Turns out Parsec does make it that on the receiving side, but it's the price to pay for online multiplayer haha. Still, I'll see what I can do about improving movement, jumping and general mobility.
I'll still post test builds and I might even make a post asking for direct playtesters. For now, I'll still leave you with some improvements I'll be making.​
Spoiler:
ATM-LMBS
Limited the use of Elents
.
My plan was to keep your actions free, you decided how to do your combos rather than having some arbitrary limit (Think Original Tales Arte Limit, by that I mean you needed to go in a chain like Base Arte > Arcane Arte) . However, due to how the plugin and RPG Maker handle skill costs, I've decided to rather limit the amount of times a single Elent can be used in a row. For example, you can't use Pyro Geiser more than three times in a row. Doing so will make Joseph take some End lag and will be unable to use said Elent until you use a different one. This, effectively forces you to mix Elents to form a combo.​
This was done and announced before, but I've improved how controllers are handled
so they will stay connected, and only players with a fighter in their corresponding slot in the Party screen will be able to fight. This means that if you disconnect Player 2's controller but leave their fighter, AI will take it's place and the game will not try to move P3's controller to P2's fighter. If you remove P2's Fighter but leave the Controller connected, it will not try to take P3's spot. That is, until you restart the game.​
Camera focus has been improved:
Now the camera will try and keep all the players in the screen. This works amazingly well, sometimes, due to how battlebacks are handled and how the camera works, players will still be able to wander a bit off camera, but not that much, since battlefield sizes are reduced depending on how many players are present.​
Escape times increase depending on the amount of players present:
This is mostly self explanatory, since the escape time was the same even if 4 players where present, so you could escape almost instantly. Now all players need to escape at the same time to be able to escape at normal speed.​
Bosses will be knockback resistant (Yes, all of them):
This was an Issue in Tales of Arise, and I did want to avoid it, however, I see it was a mistake. What I'm gonna do is the following: All bosses will be Knockback Resistant, so you can't juggle them
for a while
. However, if you get lucky and manage to stun them, via Elents, they will become temporarily able to be juggled. However, after a certain damage threshold, they will become Knockback resistant again. And to top it off, they will always have a 50-75% chance to resist Stun. This, combined with the Shield Points / Iron Stance, is part one of the boss improvements. Hopefully, this will provide a more challenging experience, while not being outright hard and turning all bosses into HP Sponges that can't be combo'ed.​
General Enemies will be improved:
First, the Slimes. Despite being the first enemies, everyone mostly has found them annoying. So, apart from increasing their move pool,
they will not bomb you with their projectiles at the battle start.
Their Elent cooldown and warmups will be randomized between some sensible values.​
G
eneral Quest Improvements:
I wanted to do some worldbuilding. The quests try and give some light into other character's story and how they connect with Joseph's and why it's
somewhat important
to the plot to complete them. At this point, in the story, all quests give info as to who's the enemy and why is everyone that joins Joseph related to said enemy. However, I do recognize it was somewhat rushed, so I'll take some time to improve it, but the priority is the battle system for now.​
Narrative changes:
My goal was to provide a bit of context as why Joseph starts where he starts without boring you with a long ass introduction. This sparked more issues but yesterday's critique gave some good pointers on how to approach this issue, while also including some better gameplay, highlighting the Multiplayer aspect of the ATM-LMBS, while not sacrificing the story, so expect a newer, revamped, and if it pleases everyone, more enjoyable intro!​
Story sections will also be trimmed. I wanted to somewhat follow the Tales narratives and how they intersect character development with the story itself, since these are not always that connected, but I think it will be better if I distance myself from that path for now.​
Visuals:
I can't change the battlers for now, FOR NOW, but do expect some bigger and with higher quality battle sprites at least. For a while, the chibi battlers will take the brunt of the critics and battles hahaha.​
General Experiences:
Expect more tutorials, info, and an Expanded Guide on some things. I thought some things of the system were clear enough, but it seems like it is not that way, so I'll explain a bit more of each feature and mechanic in the Guide, and will sometimes force-open it for you to review more of the terms!​
Music will be an important part,
however, for now only the essential and important battle themes are covered, however,
I will try to get the entire soundtrack
but that will be not possible for a long time.
​
There will not be a TL;DR for this, thank you for reading my thoughts, and even if you haven't played the game but you've seen this wall of text, I'll await your feedback, thank you!​

If you really thought  I was going to give up, that phrase is NOT ON MY DICTIONARY!
Here is the prelude, introducing the new
Completed Evolved Legacy - Linear Motion Battle System!
​
The
CEL-LMBS
takes the mantle of the old
ATM-LMBS
and raises its potential to the max, improving where the ATM version fell off short. However, it also takes on the legacy of the Original LMBS improving upon it even more, and adding features of the newest iterations of the official system while keeping an original spirit.
Completed:
Aims to take the system to the maximum possible limit to provide the closest to the official experience, without outright copying it.
Evolved:
Takes the mantle that the old ATM version left in the air.
Legacy:
Follows the spirit of the original system, within its own path.​
Stage 1
​
Improved mobilty! Jump is now smoother than ever! And so is movement.​
Improved AI! For now, there's three AI types (Smarter than ever).​
The Defender AI:
This Ally will fight normally until an Ally reaches a low HP %, then it will stay around that ally to keep foes away until it recovers, or another ally reaches an even lower HP%. If no allies are on low HP, it will fight normally.​
The Caster AI:
This Ally will always stay in the back lines, offering spell firepower and support. However, once its EP reserves deplete, it will enter melee mode to recover EP.​
The Ranged AI:
Will circle the enemy and aid the player at a medium distance, and will position itself around the battlefield as it's required.​
The idea behind these AI's is to let the players customize them, setting parameters similarly to what the Tales of Series offers (Attacking Strongest Enemy, Weakest, Fight with EP consumption in mind, prioritize Defense, and similar things) but since i've never built a menu this will take long hahaha
​
Improved Controller Handling! and Mid-Battle AI switch.​
If there's no controllers connected, the game will re-add the AI to help you in battle​
Battle Member Commands.
​
Taken from Berseria, this will allow P1 to set commands for AI allies, there will be two basic commands: Go all out or Defend. The second will prioritize defending rather than moving so allies will stand still but defend from anything. The first will re-activate the preferred or default AI's again.​
Spot for video (I'll upload it later to show the stage 1 changes)
Stage 2 (TBA)
​
Improved Menu Handling:
​
All players will be able to access their own menus, and use items and change their elents.
​
A second Elent-set will be added to each player
​
Auto-Battler Features
​
Semi-Auto mode will be added
. Some actions, such as FLUX Reload and Movement will be handled by the game, while actual attacking and Overflux abilities will still be handled by the player. (This mode will be released to the public to playstest. (Thanks OmnislashXX! This mode was thought and worked thanks to you!)
​
The player will be able to switch modes mid-battle:
With a button press, the character will show their current mode as a pop-up, and will cycle between Manual > Semi-Auto > Auto. All players will have access to these settings, so as to if you're waiting for someone to join and they connect their controller and it gets recognized, it will allow said player to change its control mode. (
Control mode in the Menu will not show the Semi-Auto mode).
​
If the battler is in Auto-Mode, the AI will control it even if  a controller is connected.

!

After a lot of sweat, tears, and countless hours of "Why the heck this isn't working?" I'm proud to announce that the CEL-LMBS has received it's biggest upgrade. Now, all Characters can have Custom Weapons! Yes. I'm gonna go a bit over how this does come as an upgrade.
Due to how the sprites are handled in the LMBS, weapons had to be included in the battler spritesheets. This, isn't necessary anymore! The new sprite system I worked can take a similarly sized image to the battler, of the weapon sprites and firmly plant it in the front of the battler. So, we came from using a single sprite
To 2 singular sprites.
And here's a video on how you can notice the new Weapon sprites. (Currently my pose sprites don't have their weapon edited out, so it looks like the character has two weapons hahaha)
For the more technical aspects.
I had to create an entirely new LmbsSpriteWeapon() class to handle weapons. Since it's kinda like a child of the original LmbsSpriteBattler() class, it was mostly easy to handle the base poses, however, since skill poses are handled differently as they're not hardcoded, and can be named anything, unlike base poses that must have the [idle], [walk] and the like suffixes, it was that hard.
So yeah, the weapon sprites must be the same dimensions of the battler sprites to be handled correctly! The good thing is that since hitboxes are handled by the actor properties, weapons are purely visual.
This was done to open the way for a bit more of content, so now characters have at least 13 weapons, 10 Base weapons (Can be bought or found), 2 Story Locked Weapons, and One special weapon (Think Catalyst Weapons (TotA), Fell Arms (ToV), Devil's Arms (ToX2, ToS, and ToA) and Shadow Somas (ToH-R). WILL NOT
receive more weapons.
This also enables me to implement my so desired costumes, hahahaha. So for costumes, my ideas are something that doesn't look too out of place. Also, Cameo Characters
WILL NOT
receive alternate costumes.
Gala

Alternate Color (Palette Swap)
This has been quite the treat for my characters lol.
Since weapons themselves were a stopping point for upgrades, the Upgrade System will be also rebuilt (won't take long). Some upgrades from the armors, mainly the Wolf and Panther Cores, which increased

Hello Everyone! I'm sorry to announce that I am
CANCELLING
the use of Speed Cast while Chain Cast is Active!
Yes, I accidentally left the condition to activate Speed Cast while Chain Cast was active. What is Chain Casting you say?
Chain Casting
is a mechanic where an actor casts a spell, inmediately reducing the casting time of the next spell, allowing for massive spell combos. In Shadows of the Earth, when Chain Casting is active, Spells will also consume 2 FLUX Units, efectively limiting the amount of spells you can use in a combo, by the amount of FLUX you have available divided by 2, so, having 30 FLUX means you have a Spell Chain limit of 15.
You can have one caster with Chain Casting active and one with normal casting active, or all with Chain or all with Normal! Create your formations to your liking! However, Chain Casting spells have their damage reduced by 25%, and Normal Spells have also a damage reduction when Speed Cast IV is active. This is to offset the insane damage amounts you can reach with Chain casting and Speed Cast IV. Casters are broken, I tell you; Titania can chain cast Absolution and it's terrifying.

Hello everyone! First, I'd like to thank the people that check this thread every now and then. Those reactions play a big part on me keeping this game up :3.
Second, I know I said I wasn't going to update the thread for a while, and, while I haven't finished the sprites. I did take a break from this to bring you:
Stage 2
​
All players can open their menus, and use items. (Thanks to Moz The Tiger for helping me with these tests)
​
Chain Casting is available for all characters!
​
Execution of Limit Elents has changed through the addition of the Limit Gauge. Each Limit Elent uses 3 LG when performed. Even if you have enough FLUX, you can't perform Limit Elents until you have at least 3 LG. LG is gained through combos, and by using the new item: Limit Bottle
​
LG is represented by a yellow bar, along with the number of current LG. All characters can only store a maximum of 9 LG
​
​
During tests, Moz and I were able to spam Limit Elents to burst our way out against enemies. And while it's fun, it's not an intended mechanic. Limit Elents must feel rewarding when able to perform them, and not like a cheap spammable tactic
TL;DR: I buffed and nerfed the Limit Elents.
Aerial Combat has been upgraded! You can now spend a bit more time comboing an enemy in the air thanks to the Aerial Delay (Internal Parameter). This allows you to reposition in the air if one of your hits whiff, so you can execute another elent.
On the Defensive Side: the Dodge function is now a true Dodge. When an attack is sucessfully dodged, the character will play an animation.
​
The Upgrade System has been reworked.
​
Cores, Plates and Sigils have not changed, but some of the items in these categories have been changed to Boost Stones.
​
Weapons can equip Boost Stones.
​
Gamepad Button Scheme has been changed, it's a bit less cluttery, and a bit less weird.
​
These are the biggest changes that have happened in the Stage 2 of the CEL-LMBS. I have encountered a roadblock as there is seemingly no other way to upgrade it. Of course, Bugs might still happen.
Thanks for reading this post!

Ever since his creation, Erif/Joseph has been the one to test all mechanics, be it good or bad. You may know his old Status bust, which has remained unchanged, while others have gotten their permanent Status Bust ever since they were integrated since all possible dimensions have been tested.​

It was also made in honor of his intentions for this journey. Remember that Erif, while a hero, he is not the chosen one, he holds no magical sword, and certainly, he wasn't foretold by a prophecy.
He's simply a man driven by revenge against an enemy that might as well dwarf him in power.
​
Now, to the update itself! Many changes have been made ever since v0.6.0 Preview, thanks to a very important person who recently joined the Discord Community. He's been testing various test builds, giving a steady source of feedback which has proved invaluable. In fact, there's two people. One has been concentrating itself on the battle system and the other on the narrative and storytelling.
First of all, we now have Input Remapping! Available for gamepads, each player can set up their favorite buttons to adapt the gameplay to their style.
While the window itself isn't really good looking, it allows you to remap all action buttons in battle. So, if you come from action games (ahem... you know who I'm talking about) you'll find yourself more comfortable thanks to the Input Remapping.
So what's this all for? Basically, v0.6.0 preview ended being just... v0.6.0. Current expected version is v0.6.5, which includes a massive changelist that basically remakes the game. There's a new story progression system, updated translations, updated mechanics, harder bosses, slightly clear objectives, less difficulty spikes, and a lot, like, a LOT more...
So, until next time!
